India Eliminated from Champions Trophy; South Africa, West Indies Advance

India has been eliminated from the Champions Trophy 2026, with South Africa and West Indies qualifying for the semi-finals. Three other teams are competing for the remaining two semi-final spots. Following South Africa's loss, they have fallen out of the top two positions in the Test Championship points table, impacting India's standing.
